column4: God knows what enters earth and what comes out of it, as well as what descends and ascends, directly pairing a covered location with emergence under divine knowledge.
God knows everything entering earth and emerging from it and remains with people wherever they are, a close formulation of hidden contents and خروج.
God splits grain and date-stone and brings living from dead and dead from living, giving the hidden seed a divinely opened and extracted life.
Rain descends and fruits are brought out as provision, an early direct parallel to pasture brought forth from earth.
Water from heaven makes earth become green, a compact nonlexical version of rain turning covered potential into visible growth.
The hearers are directed to earth and the many noble pairs caused to grow in it, focusing attention on what soil makes visible.
Rain is followed by every noble pair grown in earth, another direct rain-to-emergence scene.
The question directs human sight to the seed they sow, isolating the concealed beginning of cultivated growth.
God asks whether humans make the seed grow or He does, completing 56:63's passage from burial in soil to visible crop.
God brings water and pasture out of earth, naming both the خروج motion and the exact object of 87:4.
Grapes and fresh herbage continue the produce emerging from the split earth of 80:26-27.
Olives and palms add the trees, including the section's palm object, produced by the same opened earth.
Dense gardens complete the sequence between grain in 80:27 and fruit and pasture in 80:31.
A tree comes forth from Mount Sinai bearing oil and food, a concrete plant emerging with useful provision.
Gardens are placed in the revived ground and springs are made to burst there, continuing 36:33 from emerging grain to visible water.
The struck stone releases twelve springs, a direct instance of covered water brought into view.
Moses strikes the stone and twelve springs gush out, repeating the extraction of hidden water for each people.
Earth is burst into springs until its water meets the descending floodwater, forcefully uncovering water from below.
God best knows what is within people's selves, directly covering the inward state that may never reach the tongue.
God is Knower of the unseen in heavens and earth and knows what breasts contain, joining cosmic hiddenness to the human interior.
People say obedience publicly and then plan at night words unlike what they said, while God records the concealed revision.
They hide from people but not from God while holding night counsel about displeasing speech, an exact private-speech test of divine knowledge.
Joseph conceals his response within himself and does not disclose it to his brothers, sharply separating inward speech from utterance.
The Quran is said to be sent by the One who knows the secret in heavens and earth, joining recited revelation to knowledge of the concealed.
No self knows what delight has been hidden for it, giving خفي a concrete sense of a provision kept under divine cover until disclosure.
At judgment people cannot conceal any statement from God, marking the end of speech that could once be privately withheld.
An unseen narrative is revealed to the Prophet despite his and his people's prior ignorance, showing hidden knowledge becoming recited report.
Joseph's story is explicitly called unseen news revealed to the Prophet, another passage from concealed event to spoken revelation.
Zechariah's sign is inability to speak to people except by gesture, yet he is commanded to remember and glorify God much; inward worship persists when ordinary voice is blocked.
Zechariah's sign is that, though sound, he cannot speak to people for three nights, making the presence and absence of voiced expression explicit.
Unable to address them normally, Zechariah signals his people to glorify morning and evening, completing the silent-remembrance scene of 19:10.
God has heard the woman arguing her case and the dialogue she holds with the Prophet, making even a personal conversation fully audible to Him.
Moses asks that the knot in his tongue be loosened, bringing the section's interest in articulation down to the organ of speech.
Moses seeks clear understanding of his speech, giving the communicative purpose of the loosened tongue in 20:27.
The command to recite the Quran in measured fashion gives revealed speech an explicit vocal discipline.
Joseph is placed in the well's hidden depth while God privately reveals that he will later tell his brothers of this deed when they do not recognize him.
God shapes people within wombs however He wills, locating unseen formation inside a physical covering.
Human creation passes through concealed stages before God brings people out as children, explicitly moving womb formation into public life.
A kindled fire lights the surroundings and then God removes the light, leaving the people in darkness unable to see; visibility turns into its opposite.
Darkness, thunder, and lightning surround people who plug their ears against the blast, supplying both obscured sight and deliberately blocked sound before 2:20.
Even if a gate in heaven were opened for people to ascend through, the disclosure would lead to the dazzled-eye claim of 15:15.
God chooses Moses and commands him to listen to revelation, explicitly identifying hearing as the response to the call at the fire.
Solomon cannot see the hoopoe and asks whether it is absent, opening the bird's episode with a problem of visibility before its hidden news arrives.
The hearers describe coverings over their hearts, deafness in their ears, and a barrier between themselves and the Prophet, joining blocked inward reception with blocked sound.
People listen to the Prophet while coverings over hearts and heaviness in ears prevent comprehension, a direct reversal of effective recitation.
Those reminded of God's signs turn away while coverings remain over hearts and heaviness over ears, again making reminder inaudible through inward cover.
Barriers before and behind people are joined by a covering over them so they cannot see, a spatial image of concealed vision.
A person's public speech impresses and he invokes God regarding his heart, yet his conduct reveals fierce hostility, warning that polished utterance may cover its inward opposite.
Once the speaker of 2:204 turns away, he corrupts land and destroys crop and offspring, exposing what the impressive speech had concealed.
The command to abandon both outward and inward sin treats manifest and concealed action as equally real moral domains.
Forbidden indecencies are named in both their outward and inward forms, another ethical boundary spanning visible and concealed states.
God is named the Manifest and the Hidden while knowing all things, placing the section's paired categories at the level of divine names.
Deaf, mute, and blind, the people left in darkness by 2:17 cannot return, showing loss of voice and perception together.
Sunlight turns away from the cave while the sleepers remain within its opening, so measured light protects what God keeps concealed there.
A people at the sunrise have no covering against the sun, supplying the opposite limit to both sheltering cover and light that overwhelms vision.
A revived person given light to walk among people is opposed to one trapped in darkness, presenting light as disclosure and guidance rather than a veil.
The lamp in glass multiplies clear light and God guides to His light, a positive illuminating counterpart to the section's excessive light that blinds.
Earth is spread and prepared before 79:31 states that its water and pasture are brought out.
Earth is extended and every beautiful pair is caused to grow in it, another direct contemplation of life appearing from soil.
The Prophet's wives are told not to soften speech provocatively and to speak appropriately, regulating vocal quality rather than mere loudness.
People call the Prophet from behind private chambers, combining a spatial covering with the poorly measured address corrected by 49:2-3.
The Prophet says he does not know whether the promised event is near or assigned a long term, preparing the unseen-knowledge boundary of 72:26-27.
The unseen of heavens and earth belongs to God and the Hour can arrive in the blink of an eye, connecting its concealed time with sudden disclosure.
People extract ornaments from the sea to wear, extending خروج to a useful object removed from a hidden depth.
From the two bodies of water people eat and extract ornaments, repeating the retrieval of something concealed below the surface.
Pearls and coral come forth from the waters, a compact physical instance of hidden objects emerging.
